newsitem.title: USA: US Navy awards increase in combat supply contracts.
newsitem.headline: US Navy awards increase in combat supply contracts.

text.p: The United States Navy said Tuesday it has awarded a $200 million contract increase to the National Steel and Shipbuilding Company (NASSCO) and a $211 million contract increase to Avondale Industries Inc's Shipyard Division to build pre-positioned combat supply ships.
The ships carry the combat equipment at sea so they can move it quickly to the nearest port if the United States got involved in another Gulf-like war.
The Navy said the ship to be built by NASSCO in San Diego will carry Army equipment. It said the ship to be built by Avondale in New Orleans will carry trucks, tracked vehicles and helicopters.
